name: WinSCP
description: WinSCP’s inspected updater supplies an embedded root certificate for its update request, obtains URL/size/SHA-256 metadata, and rejects the retrieved installer on size or SHA-256 mismatch before writing it to the automatic-update path. The source does not establish payload signing-key verification.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; release-specific behavior and external TLS/framework enforcement were not independently audited.
The lower HTTP certificate matching implementation and release signing process were not audited.
